description: Original English mini knowledge-base benchmark: 24 documents, 12 single-relevance queries. Not a general multilingual benchmark.

documents.title: Plant watering
documents.text: Water indoor plants only when the top two centimeters of soil feel dry. Yellow leaves and soggy soil often indicate overwatering. Use a pot with drainage holes.

documents.title: Sourdough bread
documents.text: A sourdough starter is a living culture of wild yeast and bacteria. Feed it equal weights of flour and water daily. A bubbly starter that doubles in size can raise bread without commercial yeast.

documents.title: Bicycle puncture
documents.text: To repair a flat bicycle tire, remove the wheel and inspect the inner tube for a small hole. Roughen the rubber, apply glue, and press a patch firmly. Check the tire for sharp glass before reinstalling.

documents.title: Database backups
documents.text: Use regular database backups to recover from accidental deletion. Keep one backup offline and test restoration regularly. A backup is useful only if you can successfully restore its data.

documents.title: Password security
documents.text: Protect accounts with a password manager and unique long passwords. Enable multi-factor authentication to reduce the impact of stolen credentials. Never reuse your email password on shopping websites.

documents.title: Memory leaks
documents.text: A memory leak occurs when a program keeps references to objects it no longer needs. Monitor heap usage over time and inspect retained objects. Remove unused event listeners and clear old caches.

documents.title: Coffee extraction
documents.text: If coffee tastes bitter, the grounds may be too fine or the brew time too long. A coarser grind and shorter extraction can reduce bitterness. Freshly roasted beans also affect flavor.

documents.title: Sleep routine
documents.text: A consistent sleep schedule helps the body maintain its circadian rhythm. Avoid caffeine late in the afternoon and reduce bright screens before bed. Keep the bedroom dark and quiet.

documents.title: Composting
documents.text: Compost converts food scraps and garden waste into nutrient-rich soil. Combine green materials such as vegetable peelings with dry leaves. Turn the pile to supply oxygen and avoid meat or oily food.

documents.title: Solar panels
documents.text: Solar photovoltaic panels convert sunlight into electricity. Their output depends on sunlight, shading, and panel orientation. Batteries store excess daytime electricity for use at night.

documents.title: Train tickets
documents.text: Booking train tickets early often provides cheaper fares. Check whether a ticket is refundable before purchasing. Allow enough connection time when changing trains at a large station.

documents.title: Git undo
documents.text: Use git revert to undo a published commit by creating a new inverse commit. This preserves shared history. Avoid rewriting a branch that teammates have already pulled.

documents.title: Vector search
documents.text: Vector search represents documents as numeric embeddings. Cosine distance measures similarity between normalized vectors. It can find relevant ideas even when the query uses different words.

documents.title: Full text search
documents.text: Full-text search tokenizes words and retrieves documents containing matching terms. It is useful for exact names, product codes, and rare phrases. Hybrid search combines lexical and semantic retrieval.

documents.title: Index refresh
documents.text: After importing new documents, refresh the database search indexes before querying. Batching writes and refreshing once reduces repeated work. Do not mark a collection ready if the refresh operation failed.

documents.title: Bird migration
documents.text: Migratory birds travel seasonally between breeding and feeding grounds. Day length, weather, and food availability influence departure. Wetlands provide important resting places during long journeys.

documents.title: Camera aperture
documents.text: A wider camera aperture uses a smaller f-number and creates a shallower depth of field. This blurs the background behind a portrait. A narrower aperture keeps more of a landscape in focus.

documents.title: Emergency fund
documents.text: An emergency fund covers unexpected expenses without relying on high-interest borrowing. Keep it accessible and separate from everyday spending. The right size depends on income stability and essential costs.

documents.title: Cooking rice
documents.text: Rinse rice to remove excess surface starch. Add water, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently. Let the rice rest with the lid on after cooking so moisture distributes evenly.

documents.title: Rust prevention
documents.text: Rust forms when iron reacts with oxygen and moisture. Keep metal tools dry and apply a thin protective oil layer. Remove existing rust before repainting exposed metal surfaces.

documents.title: Browser workers
documents.text: Web Workers run JavaScript tasks in a separate browser thread. They keep the interface responsive during expensive computation. Workers exchange messages and cannot directly modify the page DOM.

documents.title: GPU fallback
documents.text: WebGPU can accelerate machine learning on the local graphics processor. If the adapter is unavailable or a model fails to initialize, use WebAssembly on the CPU. Clearly display which backend is actually running.

documents.title: Cat enrichment
documents.text: Indoor cats benefit from scratching posts, climbing shelves, and short play sessions. Rotate toys to maintain interest. Puzzle feeders encourage natural hunting behavior without overfeeding.

documents.title: Map navigation
documents.text: A compass points toward magnetic north. Combine compass direction with a paper map and visible landmarks when hiking. Download offline maps before traveling beyond mobile coverage.
